lines.text: David son of Jesse, anointed by the God of Jacob, gives these as his last words.
David says the prophet Nathan spoke through him and that God's word was on his tongue.
The Rock of Israel says a ruler who rules with justice and the fear of God is like morning light.
David says God made with him an everlasting covenant, and he trusts God to bring a long and peaceful old age.

wrong_details.wrong: a long and peaceful old age
wrong_details.true: his full salvation and every desire

lines.text: The worthless are like thorns raked aside, which a man must touch with iron or a spear shaft, and fire burns them.
